TRADE 2, TREND branch (M5 section 5.2b), LONG - the branch the TREND_UP label selects, and the same weekly-pivot breakout the report itself heads its card with. Pivot inputs: standard floor-trader formula P = (H + L + C) / 3 on the prior period, and M3 Step 8 defines the prior week as the last calendar week fully completed before D - the 2026-05-11 to 2026-05-15 cash sessions - with H the highest high and L the lowest low across every session in that week and C that week's final close. That gives P = 7428.07, R1 = 2P - L = 7510.83, S1 = 2P - H = 7333.23, R2 = P + (H - L) = 7605.67, S2 = P - (H - L) = 7250.47, and the M5 section 4a midpoint R1.5 = (R1 + R2)/2 = 7558.25. Identity check R2 - P = P - S2 = H - L = 177.6 holds. The report's weekly set (P 7437.01 / R1 7488.61 / S1 7356.89) reproduces from its own H 7517.12 / L 7385.40 / C 7408.50, but those inputs are 5.8, 39.9 and 7.5 points off the slice week, which is the disagreement that changes levels here: it moves the entry 5.9 points and the stop 20.7 points (QA feedback item 2(e)). R = 7436.3 - 7352.2 = 84.1 points = 1.10 x ATR14 (76.13), inside the mandatory [0.3, 3.0] x ATR14 band of [22.8, 228.4]; on the linter's full-day ATR14 of 83.28 it is 1.01x, still inside. R exceeds 1.00 x ATR14, so this card carries the WIDE STOP flag - set by the arithmetic, not by judgement. TP1 = weekly R1 = 7510.8, which is 74.5 points from entry and inside the 2.5 x ATR14 reach of 190.3 (208.2 on the linter's ATR). TP2 = weekly R1.5 = 7558.3. TP3 = weekly R2 = 7605.7. That is the R1 / R1.5 / R2 ladder the TREND branch specifies, not an R-multiple ladder: TP1 is 0.89R, TP2 1.45R, TP3 2.01R, and the card labels them as pivots rather than repeating the report's '+1R structural' mislabel (QA feedback 2(a)). Ladder order 7352.2 < 7436.3 < 7510.8 < 7558.3 < 7605.7 holds. No swing anchor and no fib percentage enters this card; ATR14 76.13 is used only for the stop-alternative test, the R sanity check and the 3 x ATR14 = 228.4-point runner price cap (7664.7), which sits beyond TP3 so the session-close time-stop is what actually binds the runner. Confluences stated correctly, unlike the report's card (QA feedback 2(b)): the entry sits 8.3 points above weekly P 7428.1 and 8.5 points above the slice daily R2 7427.8; the stop 7352.2 sits 18.9 points ABOVE the slice daily P 7367.1 and 13.1 points above the D-1 low 7339.1 - it is not between daily P and S1 as the report claimed. Thesis invalidation, distinct from the stop and consistent with it: a daily close back through weekly P 7428.1. It is 75.9 points from the stop, far more than the 0.15 x ATR14 = 11.4-point separation M5 section 6a requires, and it sits ahead of the stop, so the card carries the 'stop ahead of invalidation' note rather than the report's inverted claim (QA feedback 2(c)). Suppression gate tested and NOT fired: M5 section 10 suppresses Trade 2 only if every accessible pivot tier is single-source indicative. The weekly and daily tiers here are computed from the slice's own cash bars, which is the authoritative price record for this run, so both are corroborated; only the report's monthly tier was flagged indicative and no level on this card comes from it. Holding-period collision carried from the calendar: NVIDIA reports after the 20 May cash close, which is why the runner is time-stopped at that close. Linter: CLEAN, zero DUD, zero WARN.
